module.name: axm-machine-voice
module.purpose: Grounded state-native communication between the AXM Machine Floor, machines/AIs, and a deliberately primitive local human surface.

capabilities.description: Canonical grounded StateTalk packets carry machine-readable claims, evidence, relevance, next operations, and optional proposal maps without generated explanatory prose.
Strict versioned JSON adapter converts explicitly supplied state snapshots plus independently supplied active runtime context into a deterministic producer/gate outcome.
Deterministic producer can surface a strictly lower-cost alternative only when an explicit metric, evidence, and all required preserved constraints are supplied.

Deterministic producer can surface an explicit conflict only when grounded assertions share exactly the same scope, subject and property while carrying different portable values; it does not decide which assertion is true.

Deterministic producer can surface that a named bounded search remains unresolved only when at least one grounded attempt was evaluated and every supplied attempt misses at least one explicit required constraint; it does not claim no solution exists outside that search scope.

Deterministic producer can surface explicit missing required inputs inside one named supplied inventory scope; it does not infer hidden requirements or claim the missing input is unavailable outside that scope.

Deterministic producer can surface explicitly measured expected-vs-observed numeric residuals that exceed an explicitly supplied tolerance under an explicitly named metric; it does not infer cause, novelty, model invalidity, or observation invalidity.

Deterministic paired outcome producer evaluates one grounded attempt against one explicit all-required success contract: every required criterion grounded satisfied can surface success, while any grounded failed required criterion can surface failure. Claims remain relative to the supplied contract and do not authenticate its authorship or timing.

Deterministic paired history producer compares one grounded current portable pattern against one explicit same-domain prior-history scope. An exact grounded prior match can surface recurrence without complete history; bounded novelty requires no exact match plus an explicit complete-for-domain history claim. It does not authenticate historical ordering or completeness and does not claim global or scientific novelty.

Deterministic generic notice producer can surface that an explicitly named grounded notice rule fired on an explicitly referenced observation with explicit evidence. It does not infer importance, anomaly, novelty, cause, success, failure, recommendation, or other interpretation.
Offline local FloorVoice renders a fixed tiny vocabulary from StateTalk kind and supports bounded Inspect, Compare, and Acknowledge response intents without inventing actor identity.

Local append-only communication journal remembers emitted semantics, suppresses repeated speech, and records structured responses against unique emitted event ids with explicitly bounded integrity claims.
Zero-install versioned machine JSON command channel returns canonical emitted, no-candidate, rejected, recorded, or invalid outcomes without human prose.

tests.scope: core, deterministic producers, snapshot adapter, machine channel, communication journal, local bridge

not_claimed: truth of externally supplied evidence merely because a packet renders
resolution of which side of a surfaced conflict is true
global impossibility from a bounded unresolved search
global unavailability from a bounded missing-input inventory
cause or novelty merely because an expected-vs-observed residual exceeds a supplied tolerance
model invalidity or observation invalidity merely because a residual exceeds tolerance
global success or global failure from evaluation against one explicit criteria contract
authenticity, authorship, or pre-attempt timing of a supplied success criteria contract
global or scientific novelty from absence in one supplied history scope
authenticated completeness or chronological ordering of a supplied history scope
importance, anomaly, novelty, cause, success, failure, recommendation, or interpretation merely because a generic notice rule fired
cross-module interoperability before exact composition testing
actor authentication by the local FloorVoice renderer
cryptographic authenticity of the local unkeyed journal
